summary: Independent adversarial code review of f-v4-note-search at execution-branch tip 8c0f5f1 (worktree /tmp/kilo/E1546; source files byte-identical to a95876d, the commit s22b red-team live-verified on stand test2; the 9723acd..8c0f5f1 range is docs/artifacts only). Verified against spec/core.md and contract-matrix.md: q is trimmed, case-insensitive substring via strings.ToLower on both sides, owner-first scoping (ListNotes(UserID) before the filter, q can only narrow), empty/no-match yields 200 [] (non-nil slices, never null), 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Bearer is checked before method/query handling, URL-decoded q is safe across encoding classes (no panic/500), UI testids present and enforced (notes-search/notes-search-clear/notes-search-empty via TestUISemantics); client-side filtering with no request per keystroke; a single renderNotes() re-applies the active query on load/create/delete/reload; no XSS sinks (textContent/setAttribute only, inert template rows); static error envelopes without secret leakage. go build/vet/test all green (full suite ok 2.833s; 13/13 targeted tests). 0 critical/high confirmed. Findings: 3 low (512-byte q cap undocumented in spec/matrix incl. whitespace>512 -> 400 vs OD-1; per-tab search query persists across account switch without Logout — RT-E1546-1 still open; non-canonical Atoi DELETE ids — RT-08) plus 5 info notes (XSS suspicion refuted; dead note.title branch; invariants.json branch provenance; nginx edge envelope deviations; accepted self-DoS/ToLower cost).

findings.title: GET /api/notes q length cap (512 bytes -> 400 'query too long') is not documented in spec/core.md or contract-matrix.md
findings.evidence: handleNotes caps raw q at maxQueryBytes=512 and answers 400 'query too long' (RT-NEW-2 hardening, per the code comment). Spec core.md §1.1 error table and contract-matrix.md rows have no such 400; the cap is recorded only in red-team-attack-log.md:88-89 and TestNotesSearchQueryTooLong. The cap is checked before the trim/empty check, so a whitespace-only q of 513+ bytes yields 400 instead of the OD-1 'all notes' behaviour, and the byte-based cap rejects legitimate long multi-byte queries (512 bytes ≈ 170 Cyrillic runes). No security/data impact; recommend documenting the cap and its boundary semantics in spec/matrix.

findings.title: Per-tab search query (sessionStorage notebook.search) survives account switches without Logout — reconfirms red-team RT-E1546-1 (open)
findings.evidence: Successful login (lines 173-178) overwrites TOKEN_KEY/USER_KEY and redirects to /notes without clearing SEARCH_KEY; initNotes() restores the stale query whenever any token is present (line 453). SEARCH_KEY is cleared on no-token init (444), 401 (395), clear click (574) and logout (595) only. Repro: A searches on /notes -> navigates to /login without Logout -> B logs in -> B's search box is pre-filled with A's query. Exposure is the query string only (filtering stays owner-scoped; no note data). SEARCH-E2E-8 covers the no-token path only. Mitigation: clear SEARCH_KEY on successful login or key it per user. RT-E1546-1 status=open, unfixed at tip.

findings.title: DELETE /api/notes/{id} accepts non-canonical Atoi forms (007, +5, 0021)
findings.evidence: strconv.Atoi accepts '+5'/'007'/signed alternate forms; DeleteNote re-scopes to session.UserID so no cross-tenant impact. Red team reconfirmed live on a95876d as RT-08 (DELETE /api/notes/0021, +21, -21 -> owner-scoped 404; 21abc -> 400). Inherited from f-v3, unchanged by this feature; consistent with E1688 CR-F4-01.

findings.title: Suspected stored XSS via note text rendering
findings.evidence: REFUTED: note.text rendered via textContent (line 341); delete-note aria-label via setAttribute with a numeric id; template rows are inert and cloned (no phantom rows, verified in TestUISemantics); grep of app.js for innerHTML/outerHTML/document.write/eval/new Function returns zero matches. Consistent with E1688 CR-F4-04 and the s22b verdict.

findings.title: noteSearchText() matches a note.title field the API does not expose
findings.evidence: The title branch (note.title != null -> String(note.title)) is unreachable today (API wire is {id,text} only, verified by TestWireContract); deliberate future-proofing per the in-code comment; no behaviour impact (undefined -> skipped). No action required.

findings.title: invariants.json branch provenance does not match the execution branch
findings.evidence: execution_id was corrected E9294 -> E1546 in this range (resolving E1688 CR-F4-02), but the branch field still reads 'dev/f-v4-note-search' while the execution ran on 'dev/f-v4-note-search-ae079e5c' (worktree branch orc-exec-E1546). Cosmetic provenance mismatch; the invariant set itself is complete and matches the live tests.

findings.title: nginx edge layer answers HTML 400 for NUL-in-URI and 301 for GET /api instead of the app JSON envelope
findings.evidence: RT-E1546-2/3: NUL in a path is rejected by the edge/Go net/http (HTML 400, app never reached); GET /api -> 301 -> /api/ -> 404 JSON. App code is correct (handleAPINotFound serves 404 JSON for /api/); deviations are edge-layer cosmetic on RFC-invalid/edge input; traversal probes (e.g. /api/notes/%2e%2e) -> 404 JSON. No security impact; no app-code action required.

findings.title: Unbounded per-user note count and per-request O(n) ToLower (self-DoS / performance nuance)
findings.evidence: AddNote has no per-user cap; ListNotes scans all notes per request and per-request strings.ToLower over q and every note text (no full Unicode case folding, by design). In-memory app without persistence; self-DoS only, no external victim. RT-09/RT-10 accepted; search adds the per-request ToLower cost over the f-v3 baseline.
